sample_unit: low-dose chest CT cases (each read twice, 7,524 interpretations)
models_evaluated: AI assistant for lung cancer screening (unnamed)

links.outcome: Reader AUC, specificity and sensitivity with versus without AI assistance in two multireader studies
links.effect: US AUC 0.70 to 0.72 (P=.02); Japan 0.93 to 0.96 (P=.18). Specificity rose 5.5% (US) and 6.7% (Japan); sensitivity unchanged. Standalone AI AUC 0.75 (US), 0.88 (Japan).
links.quote: With AI assistance, the radiologists’ AUC increased by 0.023 (0.70 to 0.72, P = .02) for the US study and by 0.023 (0.93 to 0.96, P = .18) for the Japan study.

screen.reason: Evaluates the impact of an AI assistant compared to unassisted reading in a multireader multicase study with US and Japanese radiologists.
